notes: MCP server & Claude Code plugin management (add, deploy/undeploy per agent; browse a plugin's bundled skills). Library: Solo Skills / Plugin Skills switch. Install Skills: Git Installations now grouped by repo, collapsible, with an accurate Installed badge. Several Settings/UX fixes. All of the above in all 10 supported languages. IMPORTANT: the updater signing key was rotated (the old private key was lost) — this is the first release signed with the new key, so this version cannot verify a signature from a future release using the old chain, but it can install fine as this one download. Existing installs on 0.4.0 or earlier will not auto-update past this point until you download 0.5.0 manually once; auto-update resumes normally after that.
